blocks.text:
To shorten the code, it is possible to specify all the background properties in one
single property. This is called a shorthand property.

You can use the shorthand property
background:

blocks.caption: Example

blocks.text:
The background
property is a shorthand property for the following properties:

If some of the property values are missing, they will be set to their initial
(default) values.

rows: Sets all the background properties in one declaration
Sets whether a background image is fixed or scrolls with the rest of the page
Specifies the painting area of the background
Sets the background color of an element
Sets the background image for an element
Specifies where the background image(s) is/are positioned
Sets the starting position of a background image
Sets how a background image will be repeated
Specifies the size of the background image(s)
